title: The Price of Protein: Global Bioavailable Protein Affordability, Spatial Market Tiers, and Empirical Substitution Frontiers (v1.3)
description: Harmonized global empirical dataset (3,992,448 observed market price records across 137 countries and 95 metropolitan hubs) measuring DIAAS-adjusted bioavailable protein cost (u_USD per 50 g digestible protein) and P20 labor-minute affordability, including metropolitan commodity substitution frontiers, intra-annual seasonality volatility contrasts, and fresh-vs-shelf-stable perishability spreads.
